verdict.rationale: Anrok's Transactions API (createOrUpdate, createEphemeral, void, createNegation) lets any billing system or storefront sync/backfill transactions via API, and docs explicitly mention native Stripe and Shopify integrations feeding the same tax engine so filings aren't siloed. However, evidence only names two connectors (Stripe, Shopify) and a community comment flags that broader connector coverage (QuickBooks, NetSuite, Chargebee, Salesforce) is needed for multi-processor businesses without confirming Anrok ships those. Missing for 10: documented connectors beyond Stripe/Shopify, explicit historical/bulk backfill tooling, and independent confirmation that filings aggregate correctly across mixed channels.
